verdict.rationale: Fellow documents configurable, organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention. Its Super Admin API lets Enterprise admins retrieve, export and delete workspace data, including a dedicated delete-note endpoint, to erase data in line with privacy regulations. Transcript redaction is also listed. Missing for 10: retention-policy configuration is described only on marketing pages without detailed docs; API deletion is restricted to Enterprise super admins rather than individual users; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
